registeredBy: Sam (owner); registered on his instruction to close the predictive econometrics gaps, before any run of this test
hypothesis: The app's inflation forecast rule (AR on monthly y/y inflation, lag 0-13 by BIC, last 120 months), fitted at each origin on the series as published that day, has a lower RMSE than carrying the newest published figure on, 3 and 12 months ahead, scored against each month's first published figure. US (ALFRED CPIAUCSL, % y/y) and euro area (ECB real-time database HICP, % y/y), pooled.
knownLimits: Same model rule as cpi_forecast v2, which failed on today's data; this test asks whether the verdict holds on data as first published, not a re-test of that rule. A pass here does not change the cpi_forecast verdict.
Price indices are revised less than GDP (mostly seasonal factors), so this test is expected to differ little from the pseudo real-time one.
